verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal processes merchant and customer payment data, so asking whether that data can be excluded from AI model training is a fair privacy question for this kind of product. The evidence pack covers POS integration, readers, offline payments, receipts, the MCP server and the CLI. None of it documents an AI-training opt-out or any data-use policy, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
